weights.admissibility: there exist constants 0<m<=M<infinity with m alpha_n<=beta_n<=M alpha_n for every n

comparison.criterion: the weighted Hilbert topologies are boundedly isomorphic exactly when both ratio bounds hold

transport.bounded_history: B bounded on H_alpha implies B bounded on H_beta with ||B||_beta<=||B||_alpha/sqrt(m)
transport.kernel: the algebraic and closed kernel set is unchanged under the identity comparison
transport.faithfulness: (B,P_kernel) remains faithful, although the orthogonal projection depends on the weight
transport.bounded_operator: T transports by I T I^-1 with condition-number loss
transport.similarity_spectrum: preserved for bounded operators under this declared similarity

metric_strength.noise_whitening: not physically calibrated by equivalence alone

hostile_boundary.consequence: different completions may contain different sequences and cannot be silently identified

next_required_object.acceptance: derive a candidate source/noise weight beta_n and prove uniform upper and lower ratio bounds against alpha, or accept a different completion with explicit nontransportable conclusions
